- [u-L0003-07] Caelynn prepares some tea while the rest of the supplies are loaded in the wagon.

- [u-L0009-13] They continue up the path until they reach the next small hill.
- [u-L0011-01] Stafl is on first watch, with little happening, until the sky darkens further and he can just make out a huge swarm of wings.

- [u-L0013-05] After a brief discussion, they agree to press on to the swamp.

- [u-L0015-02] As the forest finally reaches the fortifications, the fires are lit in the ditches.

- [meta-session-0021-locations] session locations location places place setting map mirathorn elderwyld cities and towns cities and towns mossford young_drake_nest_hill Major session set-piece: iridescent young drake nest bowl with elder drakes and loot. unknown sites unknown sites young drake nest hill young drake nest hill edge_of_the_world Sheriff rumor destination for cultist music conversion; named northbound town. edge of the world edge of the world mireward Named next town north on the road (~5 days out per Lysandra).
- [u-L0005-08] After conferring with Lysandra, they determine that they are 3 days from Mirathorn and the next little town north along the road will be Mireward, about 5 days out.
- [u-L0005-06] They leave the wagon and the animals at the bottom and make their way up until they reach a giant bowl of water surrounded by a grove of trees.
- [u-L0003-12] He warns the group about rumors coming from a town to the north about cultists using music to convert others.
- [u-L0005-07] From this position they can see out along the plains for a fairly long distance.
- [meta-session-0021-open-loops] session unresolved open questions loops open loops actionable follow up next session mirathorn_festival_resumed Mirathorn resumed the Festival; Frank hung up; Lysandra cannot get through — is the city compromised or merely distracted? elderwyld cities and towns cities and towns mirathorn swamp_vs_mirathorn_fork Party agreed to press on to the swamp rather than turn back — S22 opening pressure. longmont campaign longmont campaign campaign 2 parties questionable company questionable company
- [u-L0021-03] Stafl starts sorting through the provisions, convinced that someone snuck in the tainted meat before leaving Mirathorn.
- [u-L0003-07] Caelynn prepares some tea while the rest of the supplies are loaded in the wagon.
- [u-L0003-13] The town, called Edge of the World, is about a one week trip to reach.
- [u-L0003-14] They warn the sheriff about tainted meat and Karsemine uses her Thaumaturgy to show them what to look for when people begin to change.
- [u-L0005-01] They continue on north with Karsemine and Caelynn keeping an eye out for high ground for a place to stop for the night.
- [u-L0005-03] Because of their timing leaving the town and their navigation skills, the wagon is able to make it far enough north to just hit the very edge of the storm and only get soaked.
- [u-L0009-13] They continue up the path until they reach the next small hill.
- [u-L0011-01] Stafl is on first watch, with little happening, until the sky darkens further and he can just make out a huge swarm of wings.
- [u-L0013-04] Now the group must decide: continue on their mission to the swamp, or turn back and see what is happening at the city.
- [u-L0013-05] After a brief discussion, they agree to press on to the swamp.
- [u-L0013-09] The rest of the Questionable Company decide to take a short rest as their final preparation.
- [u-L0015-02] As the forest finally reaches the fortifications, the fires are lit in the ditches.
- [u-L0017-07] Lysandra tells her that she can't remember much after the group left, only that she decided to go around the forest and she could smell meat while trying to sleep.
- [u-L0021-05] Mixed in with the meat is cleverly disguised tainted meat.
- [u-L0021-07] Caelynn calls Sara to tell her the good news about Lysandra, and bad news about the tainted meat.
- [meta-session-0020-locations] session locations location places place setting map mirathorn elderwyld cities and towns cities and towns mossford migrating_forest migrating forest migrating forest stormspire_academy stormspire academy stormspire academy half_burned_warehouse Repeated, specific Mossford child-gang scene location; not present in Mossford dossier collection. dossiers mossford location dossiers half burned warehouse half burned warehouse voices_tower_blueprint Lysandra draws a top-down tower blueprint under cult-
- [meta-session-0020-open-loops] session unresolved open questions loops open loops actionable follow up next session half_burned_warehouse Should the half-burned warehouse be promoted as a Mossford location dossier, or folded into an existing Mossford district dossier such as Dense Worker Housing? elderwyld cities and towns cities and towns mossford location dossiers mossford location dossiers half burned warehouse half burned warehouse professor_merril_tealeaf Should Professor Tealeaf receive a dedicated NPC hub under Stormsp
- [u-L0003-01] While still waiting for a response Caelynn studies the sky once again.
- [u-L0003-03] The group then decides to load up the wagon and head out in hopes of beating the storm.
- [u-L0003-04] They plan to head back up the main road through town and continue north.
- [u-L0003-06] Stafl and Lysandra, both in need of a good rest, lay down in the back of the wagon, using this time to recharge while they travel.
- [u-L0003-08] As the wagon approaches town it is clear that they are having a celebration.
- [u-L0003-10] He is quickly approached by the sheriff, who is not happy about the news during the celebration.
- [u-L0005-05] Karsemine and Caelynn spot a good camping spot on the top of a conical hill.
- [u-L0005-09] Everyone gets comfortable, sentries are posted, and they get a peaceful night's rest.
- [u-L0005-10] After another uneventful night, the group grabs their belongings and begins to walk back down to the wagon.
- [u-L0005-11] As soon as they start Bonogo sees a huge double rainbow.
- [u-L0005-13] Bonogo is convinced that there is something on the next hill over where the rainbow appears to end.
- [u-L0005-15] The group decides to make a short detour to the hill Bonogo thinks the rainbow ended on.
- [u-L0007-01] Karsemine, always keeping a sharp eye on her surroundings, is the first to notice something just off the trail.
- [u-L0007-03] She shows it to Caelynn to make an arcana check, but she can't tell anything about it.
- [u-L0007-04] As the group continues up the path the number of scales laying around continues to grow until it becomes obvious something is up ahead.
- [u-L0007-05] Karsemine becomes very nervous about reaching the top and finding something waiting.
- [u-L0007-06] While Caelynn creates Good Berries for everyone, Karemine scouts ahead.
- [u-L0007-08] Karsemine sneaks back to the group and warns them that something is definitely living here.
- [u-L0007-09] Bonogo does not want to leave without taking a look himself, so Karsemine casts Pass Without a Trace and they both sneak back up.
- [u-L0007-10] They slowly make their way back through the remaining brush to the lip of the bowl and suddenly Bonogo is overwhelmed with the scent of reptiles.
- [u-L0007-11] Down below on the floor of the bowl they can see a large amount of winged reptiles, between 40 and 50, and the remains of countless animal corpses along with human corpses with some remaining gear.
- [u-L0007-13] Despite the danger, Bonogo is convinced the "treasure" is on the human remains and tells the rest of the group that this is a big score waiting to be picked up.
